text:
Dana: Quick alert - AuroraHost changed two marketplace SKUs and split our 16-node reservation into two aliases. Reservation `aur-resv-1601` now unresolved. Need 16x H100-equivalent in us-east-1 for the enterprise trial starting Wed 06:00 UTC (72h). Can procurement/ops advise?

inventory-bot: SYNC_ERROR: MULTI_ALIAS for aur-resv-1601
```
error: MULTIPLE_SKU_ALIASES_FOUND
reservation: aur-resv-1601
sku_candidates: AUR-H100-v1, AUR-H100-pro
```

Victor: Vendor message: they deprecated `AUR-H100-v1` and introduced `AUR-H100-pro`. They also split inventory across two partner data centers. Lead-time changed 4d -> 11d. We have 6 nodes in our Dedicated pool in us-east-1, 4 in partner-managed racks (requires delegation), and 6 are on partial ship (ETA 7d).

ops-oncall: Short window here. If trial is non-negotiable we can: (A) reallocate 10 from internal non-prod (CI/dev) + 6 from Dedicated (painful), (B) use hybrid Dedicated + partner-hosted + temporary cross-region routing, (C) request partner emergency partial ship (costly).

procurement-bot: Market hold status for aur-resv-1601: PENDING_ALIAS_RESOLVE. Emergency hold quote: +45% premium for immediate allocation, non-refundable.

Maya: Customer trial is with an enterprise SI; they expect full 16 nodes. Marketing/SDR already scheduled hands-on sessions. Scaling down would break commitments. Any way to merge the two SKUs into a single internal alias so reservation resolves?

Victor: We can map both SKUs to internal alias `aur-h100-merged-2026` and treat the pools as equivalent at the endpoint layer, but Console needs a multi-pool reservation feature toggled and routing weight config. That avoids cross-region but requires product change + quick canary.

ops-oncall: I can patch the mapper to accept both aliases and create a composite reservation referencing two pools. ETA 90m for patch + canary. Also need product to add route weight `aurora/trial/* -> pool(dedicated=0.6,partner=0.4)` for the 72h window.

procurement-bot: Partner delegation paperwork required for partner-managed racks. Legal: short SOW addendum?

LegalBot: We can fast-track a short addendum under current MSA. Need finance approval for the premium if we take emergency hold. ETA legal review 60m.

Dana: Action items:
1) @Victor confirm mapping AUR-H100-v1 + AUR-H100-pro -> `aur-h100-merged-2026` and request mapper patch
2) @ops-oncall implement composite reservation canary and create route weight for Wed 06:00 -> Sat 06:00 UTC
3) @procurement-bot start partner delegation + emergency hold quote if mapping fails
4) @Maya inform SI about potential minor config shift and confirm trial must run as-is

Victor: Mapping request sent. Waiting on inventory-bot to re-run sync.

inventory-bot: Alias mapping updated: AUR-H100-v1, AUR-H100-pro -> aur-h100-merged-2026. Re-run scheduled.

ops-oncall: Canary for composite reservation created and routing weight prepared. Need product toggle to enable multi-pool reservations. Tagging @Dana for approval.

Dana: Approve product toggle for trial window. Approve canary.

procurement-bot: Emergency hold standing by but not charged. We will only fund if mapping fails or partner refuses delegation.

Maya: I'll message SI and ask them to be on standby. If they insist on physical co-location we escalate.

inventory-bot: Reservation aur-resv-1601 now RESOLVED -> aur-h100-merged-2026. Composite reservation active across Dedicated + partner pools.

Dana: Nice work. Keep monitoring and please post any metric alerts. If the mapping flips again we trigger emergency hold and notify legal/finance immediately. :white_check_mark:
